## `What is life course research?`

<br>

LCR is a **core concept** in sociology and an **interdisciplinary approach** that studies [interconnected]{.fragment .highlight-red} life [domains]{.fragment .highlight-red} over [time]{.fragment .highlight-red},  acknowledging how human decisions are embedded within social structures, institutions, and historical periods and places.

## `Course outline`

<br>

The class will have a threefold focus:

* Understand the interdisciplinary conceptual foundations of LCR

* Familiarise yourself with substantive LC research
